name: ns-wry-app
description: NativeScript test app for @cross-code/ns-wry — displays a WebView with google.com on the first page.

scripts.build.plugin: cd ../../ && pnpm exec nx run ns-wry:build
scripts.run.ios: pnpm run build.plugin && ns run ios --emulator
scripts.run.android: pnpm run build.plugin && ns run android --emulator
scripts.run.ios:clean: rm -rf platforms/ios && pnpm run build.plugin && ns run ios --emulator
